name: Terminal
description: A shell in a tab, opened in the vault's folder, to run a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor) on your notes. Runs on this machine, or on your other machines (Machines); closing the tab keeps the shell going. An agent started here is told it runs inside Vaultite, plus each plugin's line for agents: Show what agents in terminals are told has it word for word.

backend.label: Where new shells run
backend.description: Vaultite keeps them running on its own, with the page's own scrollback; tmux, when it's installed, keeps them in a tmux server (tmux -L vaultite attach reaches them from any terminal). Shells already running stay where they are

scrollback.label: Scrollback
scrollback.description: lines of history each terminal keeps, all of them shown again when you come back to it, whether it runs in Vaultite or tmux; new terminals take a change

allowUsers.label: Other tailnet logins
allowUsers.description: tailnet logins besides this machine's owner that may open terminals through Tailscale Serve, like someone@example.com

allowRemote.label: Anyone who reaches the app
allowRemote.description: lets anyone who reaches the app open terminals, not only this machine's owner and the logins above: only on a network you trust
